name: Linear regression with k-fold structure selection
name_cn: 线性回归 + k 折选型
when: 响应连续、因子连续，要估计单个因子的偏效应，且要在几个候选结构里选一个
when_not: 响应是有界比例（0-1）或计数 → 该用 GLM；因子全是类别 → 该用 ANOVA
assumptions: The response is approximately linear in the factors over the sampled region: the residuals show no systematic curvature against fitted values.
Residual variance is constant, or robust standard errors are used and said to be used; the Breusch-Pagan statistic records which applies.
Observations are mutually independent. Repeated measurements, nested groups, or serial time dependence violate this.
No single observation dominates the fit: no Cook distance exceeds 1.
breaks_when: The response is bounded or a proportion: a linear predictor can leave the admissible range, and coefficients stop being marginal effects.
Two or more factors are nearly collinear (design condition number above 1000): individual coefficients become uninterpretable even though predictions may still be accurate.
Fewer than about 20 observations: fold-to-fold variance is large enough that the cross-validated error is itself unstable.
An unobserved confounder is present: the coefficient is an association, not an effect, and must not be written as one.
report_must_include: Breusch-Pagan statistic and its critical value
refs: Stone, M. (1974). Cross-validatory choice and assessment of statistical predictions. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society B, 36(2), 111-147.
Breusch, T. S. and Pagan, A. R. (1979). A simple test for heteroscedasticity and random coefficient variation. Econometrica, 47(5), 1287-1294.
